text_block_list.text:
...Hey. Don't you think you've won
enough
already?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: You wanted me to give it my best.

text_block_list.text:
Hmph, well there's no questioning your
skills. So
that's how you judge timing,
huh?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
...Anyway, what are we going to do with
all these?
Maybe we can give them to
the student council?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан

text_block_list.text:
But then I'd have to carry them over
there and
walk into the student council
office with an armful
of plushies...
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
choice_data_list: I think they'll be all smiles.

text_block_list.text: ...You think this is funny, don't you?
text_block_list.name: Нарита Брайан
